# @amykit/plugin-file-brief-store

Briefs kept as one file per item.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `brief` port.

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-file-brief-store
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-file-brief-store"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-file-brief-store":
    directory: "briefs"
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `directory` | `string` | no | `briefs` | where briefs are kept, relative to the host-selected artifact root |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
